interruption_backend_limitation.observation: After in-flight callback navigation succeeds and its fence finishes, restored interruption can close a persistent FileChannel during later writer cleanup. Immediate next-writer recovery may reuse that closed cached channel.
interruption_backend_limitation.required_oracle: Only SirixIOException rooted in ClosedByInterruptException is accepted for interrupted cleanup. An injected earlier cache error remains primary and the reader close error remains in suppression order. Subsequent admission may reject only with the precise ClosedChannelException cause and must restore the permit; closing/reopening the backend must then read committed value 1.
interruption_backend_limitation.status: The cached-channel reuse behavior is reported, not fixed or represented as successful immediate admission. It is outside the cold reader-order correction; active callback reads are never allowed to fail.
